title: Motion video demo
note: Beats are 1-based: beat n is at offset + (n - 1) * 60 / bpm. duration = bars * 240 / bpm (here 4 bars). Cues with hit: true are checked for picture/sound sync by qa.py; `pictureSyncWindow` widens its search/accept window from the default 4 frames. Optional lag-proof tuning (see lagproof.py): `holds`: [[start, end], ...] (s) -- declared still windows, each should be <= 0.3 s; `lagThreshold` -- still-vs-moving cutoff, either one number or a per-scale {"full": N, "preview": M} object (a preview encode is often far more destructive to subtle motion than the final -- pitfall 59); calibrate both with `lagproof.py --blocks` on the encode you actually ship. This demo's own values (grain alpha 0.16, camera drift ~20-40 px swings, engine.js/index.html) were calibrated exactly this way. `lagProofEnd` -- seconds to check (default the whole `duration`; exclude a deliberately static final hold if you have one). Web-encode budget (build.mjs): `webSizeBudget` (MB, default 10) and `webCrf` (starting CRF, default 20, steps up to 28). Formats: 1920x1080 (16:9), 1080x1920 (9:16), 1080x1080 (1:1).
